interpretation: Offline preference optimisation (DPO/ORPO) needs only forward/backward over fixed data and is expressible on this stack. Online RL (GRPO, PPO, RLVR) additionally needs autoregressive sampling inside the training loop, which requires a decode graph co-resident with the training graph on the same two NeuronCores. TRL's standard escape hatch is vLLM, which on Neuron is an inference-only stack running on separate hardware.
